subject: FYI: You can also use you regular email address to join this group

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: FYI: You can also use you regular email address to join this group
parts:
Hi,

although it does not really apply existing members of this group, I
would like to share with you that it is indeed possible to join the
aroma.affymetrix group using a non-Gmail email address. I say this
because I have noticed that a lot of you are using your Gmail
addresses, and I'm not sure if you are aware of the alternatives. In
order to join the group using a non-Gmail address you can either:

1) Assign the email address to your existing Google Account that comes
with your Gmail account, cf.

http://www.google.com/support/accounts/bin/answer.py?answer=86635

2) Create a separate Google Account for the email address, cf.

http://www.google.com/support/accounts/bin/answer.py?answer=27440

Note, you cannot merge Google Accounts, so if you create a separate
one by Option (2), you cannot later use that email address in Option
(1) above.

Please let others know about these options.

Just my $0.02.

Henrik
